channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Gold hits record $5,311 as dollar falls ahead of Fed decision
item.description: Gold prices climbed above $5,300 per ounce for the first time today, driven by economic uncertainty and a weakening U.S. dollar, as investors awaited the Federal Reserve’s policy decision amid increasing concerns over its independence.

item.title: Fed holds rates steady amid ‘elevated’ inflation
item.description: WASHINGTON >> The Federal Reserve held interest rates steady today, citing still-elevated inflation alongside solid economic growth, and giving little indication in its latest policy statement of when borrowing costs might fall again.

item.title: 2 agents who shot Pretti are on leave, Trump official says
item.description: The two federal agents who opened fire on a Veterans Affairs nurse in Minneapolis have been on leave since the shooting, an official with the Department of Homeland Security said for the first time today.

item.title: HFD: McCully home fire caused by e-scooter’s lithium-ion battery
item.description: The Honolulu Fire Department has determined that a blaze in McCully over the weekend was caused by a lithium-ion battery from an e-scooter. The case has been classified as accidental.

item.title: Gabbard attends FBI search of Georgia election office for 2020 ballots
item.description: WASHINGTON >> The FBI searched an election office in Georgia’s Fulton County outside Atlanta today, pursuing President Donald Trump’s false claims that his 2020 election defeat was the result of widespread voting fraud.

item.title: Lifeguards rescue distressed swimmer off Manana Island
item.description: Honolulu Ocean Safety Department lifeguards this morning rescued a swimmer in distress in waters off Manana Island.

item.title: Starbucks ignored maggots and fire risks, ex-VP’s lawsuit alleges
item.description: SEATTLE >> A former Starbucks vice president is suing the Seattle-based coffee giant over wrongful termination and sex discrimination allegations.

item.title: No. 3 Hawaii sweeps Saint Francis in opening road match
item.description: Kainoa Wade put down a match-high 14 kills and the third-ranked Hawaii men’s volleyball team won its opening road match of the season, defeating Saint Francis 25-23, 25-14, 25-10 today at DeGol Arena in Loretto, Pa.

item.title: Riders ill after passenger sprays unknown ‘chemical’ on TheBus
item.description: First responders were called to a hazardous chemical incident on TheBus while it was in Kalihi today.

item.title: Videos show Alex Pretti in confrontation with agents 11 days before his death
item.description: MINNEAPOLIS >> The nurse who was fatally shot by federal agents in Minneapolis on Saturday was pushed to the ground by different agents at a protest 11 days before he was killed, according to newly unearthed videos that show him spitting and cursing at them and kicking a taillight on one of their SUVs.
